subject: Micro-demo order change, moderator shift & live captions plan
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rita.sokolov@acmeai.com, l10n@translatepro.com
Cc: events@zoom.us
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Micro-demo order change, moderator shift & live captions plan

Team / Rita / L10n,

Quick note as we lock the run-of-show for next Wednesday's micro-demo series (Oct 21). Two coordination asks that surfaced from the product team and Rita this morning:

1) Swap the second and third micro-demos to surface the new low-latency demo earlier (reduces risk for the live Q&A).
2) Add live English captions + on-the-fly translated captions (Spanish + German) for the panel portion — vendor (TranslatePro) to confirm capability and latency SLA.

I attached run_of_show_v3.pdf with the proposed slot swap and captioning_specs.xlsx with our expected cues (start/stop markers, speaker labels for the captions). Main concerns: minimal AV rehearse time, and ensuring the moderator is briefed on switch timing (we'll move the moderator handoff to 00:02:45 of segment two).

Action items I'm proposing now:
- Laura: can you update the calendar invites and confirm the host/registrant emails get the updated schedule?
- Ava: can you run a 20-min AV pre-check with Rita + TranslatePro on Tue at 3pm PT?
- Marissa: please update the external speaker comms (one-paragraph note to attendees) so the reorder is not confusing.
- L10n: confirm Spanish/German live captions are possible within <5s latency and outline any additional token costs.

Rita — tagging you for acknowledgement. If you prefer we keep original ordering, say so and we'll push the low-latency demo into the final slot with an extended Q&A.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Karthik,

Confirmed on my side — I'll update the calendar, adjust the host/guest join links, and resend invites. Two quick notes:
- Registrant email should call out the change as "demo order update" so it doesn't look like a cancellation.
- AV pre-check: Tue 3pm PT works for me. Can we get a Zoom test meeting link that includes interpretation/captioning settings turned on?

I'll attach the new calendar export once done.

Laura Bennett

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:03:21 -0400
Subject: Re: Micro-demo order change, moderator shift & live captions plan

Thanks Karthik — swapping the low-latency demo earlier is fine with me and actually preferable (we want the freshest impression during peak attendance). A few requests from my side:
- Can the low-latency demo keep the same data subset (prod-sim-2026-09) so we avoid new regressions?
- If possible, keep the demo to 6 minutes + 4-minute handoff to moderator (tight slots will keep the session energetic).

I'll join the Tue 3pm PT AV pre-check. Also, can someone send a short speaker brief (2 bullets) about the demo to my co-presenter, Mei Chen (mei.chen@acmeai.com)?

Best,
Rita Sokolov
Principal Engineer, Integrations | Acme AI
rita.sokolov@acmeai.com

From: l10n@translatepro.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rita.sokolov@acmeai.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Micro-demo order change, moderator shift & live captions plan

Hi all — quick availability + technical note from TranslatePro: we can provide live captions in English + Spanish + German. A few details: 
- Expected caption latency: 3.5s on our standard streaming model; we can move to lower-latency model (2.2s) for an additional setup fee.
- We need 10 minutes of dedicated setup time on the event Zoom host account to confirm language channels and speaker-label integration.
- We support subtitle burn-in for recorded assets if you want the post-event video to have captions embedded.

We saw the captioning_specs.xlsx attached — everything looks good except the speaker label IDs; please confirm those map to the Zoom participant IDs (we can receive a CSV mapping ahead of Tue's check).

— Sofia at TranslatePro
L10n Operations | TranslatePro

----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rita.sokolov@acmeai.com, l10n@translatepro.com, events@zoom.us
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Micro-demo order change, moderator shift & live captions plan

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick confirmations / next steps: 
- Laura: please update invites and send the updated calendar export by EOD Mon.
- Ava: schedule Tue 3pm PT AV pre-check (Zoom link is in related_links) and include a 10-min window for TranslatePro to test.
- Marissa: I'll draft the 2-bullet speaker brief for Mei and Rita and share it in a separate email by noon tomorrow.
- TranslatePro: the 2.2s low-latency option is probably worth the fee; can you send a short quote for that setup and confirm we can do the setup on the host account?

Attachments: run_of_show_v3.pdf (PDF) — highlights the swapped slots and moderator cue times; captioning_specs.xlsx (Excel) — language channels + speaker label mapping template.

I'll update the run-of-show link once Laura uploads the calendar export. Thanks all — feeling good about this one.

Karthik
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
